title: Brilliant moves don't exist
post:
Brilliant moves don't exist 🤯 Stockfish only gives a number. The !! is a sticker 👀 How many brilliants have you played? Comment your number 👇
Find yours free on chessigma.com (link in bio).
#ad #chessigma #chess #brilliantmove #magnuscarlsen #stockfish #chesstok

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: Stockfish can beat any human. But it has never seen a brilliant move.
phrases.say: Stockfish can beat any human. [pause] But it has never seen a brilliant move.

phrases.text: New York, 2016. On his birthday, Magnus Carlsen plays for the world title... and gives away his queen.
phrases.say: New York, twenty sixteen. On his birthday, Magnus Carlsen plays for the world title... [pause] and gives away his queen.

phrases.text: A grandmaster called it the most brilliant final move in championship history.
phrases.say: [impressed] A grandmaster called it the most brilliant final move in championship history.

phrases.text: Stockfish calls it: mate in two. Just a number.
phrases.say: Stockfish calls it: [deadpan] mate in two. [pause] Just a number.

phrases.text: The double exclamation mark is a sticker. A review site adds it later, by its own rules.
phrases.say: The double exclamation mark is a sticker. [pause] A review site adds it later, by its own rules.

phrases.text: Chess.com's rule: a good piece sacrifice. And it's more generous for new players.
phrases.say: Chess dot com's rule: a good piece sacrifice. [pause] And it's more generous for new players.

phrases.text: So the same move can be brilliant for you, and just a move for Magnus.
phrases.say: So the same move can be brilliant for you... and just a move for Magnus.

phrases.text: So... how many brilliant moves have you played?
phrases.say: So... [pause] how many brilliant moves have you played?

phrases.text: Chessigma's free review can tell you.
phrases.say: Chessigma's free review can tell you.

phrases.text: It flags every brilliant move... like this one.
phrases.say: It flags every brilliant move... [pause] like this one.

phrases.text: And it finds all of yours. Just type a username.
phrases.say: And it finds all of yours. [pause] Just type a username.

phrases.text: I tried GothamChess: 141 brilliants in three months.
phrases.say: I tried Gotham Chess: [pause] one hundred forty-one brilliants in three months.

phrases.text: An Elo for every part of his game, and every brilliant and tactic he played.
phrases.say: An Elo for every part of his game... and every brilliant and tactic he played.

phrases.text: Find yours free on chessigma.com. Link in bio, and comment your number.
phrases.say: Find yours free on Chessigma dot com. [pause] Link in bio, and comment your number.

_voice_notes: v1 (25.11.2026): Chessigma video 1 as the sponsor asked on 25.11, the pitch of 9.11. Numbers and site names are spelled out in `say` (Chess.com = Chess dot com, Lichess = Lee-chess, 2016 = twenty sixteen). Takes (tools/voice_check.py --takes, 25.11): bait 1, ny 2, ad1 3 — in the default readings one sentence stood 2.7–3.5 dB over the others ('Sigma.' the quietest). v3 (27.11.2026): Eliot's integration of 26.11 — the video to 'just a move for Magnus', then their voiceover word for word over their B-roll (GothamChess = Gotham Chess, 141 = one hundred forty-one, chessigma.com = Chessigma dot com in `say`).
